notes:
Probably the most annoying thing for me in animations / scrollable content is how easy it is to just clip the content. Even if there is no border around to clip it with, adding masks is a one-liner in css now. (slowed down transition)

Designer: @blvdmitry. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
